name: Cooldown Bars
author: MarshalX
description: A draining bar for every ability you have on cooldown, soonest ready first, measured against the real length of anything in your own spellbook. Draws as a column of named bars or as a strip of swept icons, and both are yours to drag to the size you want them.

preview.alt: On the left, Bars, a column of named, draining bars, soonest ready at the top. On the right, Icon strip, the same cooldowns as square icons, each swept and counting down.

settings.label: Most bars to show at once
Hide cooldowns shorter than the global cooldown
Tint each timer by its damage school
